text:
anya_cs: quick heads-up 1 MarinerAI audit delivery issue. Their SOC isn't seeing any logs from our private deployment. They opened a ticket, attaching sample request-id. Can infra/security take a look?

mariner_ops: thanks @anya_cs. we've got a spike in audit drop rate starting 02:30 UTC. Cloud console shows failed PutObject to our delivery-bucket with KMS:Decrypt errors, plus connection resets to our SIEM collector.

josh_infra: looking now. two parallel things often: 1) VPC egress (NAT / firewall) blocking outbound to collector IPs, 2) incorrect S3 bucket policy or missing kms:Decrypt for the log-forwarder role.

nora_sec: dug into the KMS key policy quickly 1 the key ARN is alias/mariner-logs-key. Current key policy allows account root and a role arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/mariner-log-writer-old. But the forwarder role the runtime uses is arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/mariner-log-writer. mismatch -> AccessDenied on Decrypt.

ellie_support: mariner sent the forwarder role ARN and SIEM collector IPs 34.203.12.45, 52.12.99.2. They also mentioned their security team recently tightened egress rules and expect to allow only 443 to specific ranges.

ingest-bot: Log-forwarder-check: recent PutObject failures = 17 in last 10m. KMS errors = 14. Network connection resets = 6.

anya_cs: customer's worried about compliance: they need 13-month retention and verified delivery this week for their audit timeline. This is now a potential renewal risk if we can't demonstrate delivery within 72h.

josh_infra: temporary mitigation: i can create an IAM grant and add the exact runtime role into the key policy so they can continue writing while we align names. but prefer customer to update key policy themselves. I will paste a minimal snippet.

nora_sec: prefer least privilege policy; suggest adding a Principal with the exact role and only kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. snippet: 

```
{
  "Sid": "AllowMarinerForwarder",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::555666777:role/mariner-log-writer"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

nora_sec: also they should rotate grants if they change roles again. i'll follow up with a short runbook.

mariner_ops: can you also confirm how we can verify which KMS key was used for a given object? our SOC wants mapping request-id -> key id.

ellie_support: we can expose that mapping in audit logs; i'll file a doc request for console mapping. For now mariner can run `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-mariner-logs --key <object-key>` which returns `ServerSideEncryption` and `SSEKMSKeyId`.

josh_infra: network fix: @mariner_ops please check your egress firewall for TLS termination/proxy that might be terminating connections. If their firewall inspects TLS and re-signs certs, the collector may reject. As a quick test, can you curl the collector endpoint from a bastion in your VPC? Example: `curl -v https://34.203.12.45/healthz`

mariner_ops: ran curl from bastion 1 response 502 and TLS handshake failure. they're opening a ticket with their network ops.

anya_cs: action items summarized: 1) Add role to KMS policy or grant -> owner nora_sec, ETA today 18:00 UTC. 2) Customer to confirm egress allowlist / TLS passthrough with their firewall -> owner mariner_ops + josh_infra, ETA 6h. 3) Short enablement walkthrough on verifying delivery + S3/KMS mappings -> owner ellie_support, ETA tomorrow 14:00 UTC. 4) Temporary extension offer for audit window if delivery delays caused by our onboarding -> owner anya_cs, ETA upon resolution.

nora_sec: i'll provide the policy snippet and a one-liner to verify role identity: `aws sts get-caller-identity --profile forwarder-role` and `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://testblob` (test in a sandbox).

josh_infra: I'll also deploy a short-lived VPC endpoint log sink to prove end-to-end delivery in our staging account and share a signed pre-signed URL so SOC can validate receipt without changing firewall rules.

mariner_ops: appreciate the fast triage. SOC asked for a compliance note we can share with auditors if we confirm delivery. we may need a short attestation template.

ellie_support: noted, i'll draft a one-page attestation template stating "logs delivered to customer-managed SIEM via encrypted S3 with KMS key id <id> and retention N days" once we have final key id and retention config.

anya_cs: thanks team. reconvene in this thread after nora posts the key update and josh posts the staging sink URL. tagging follow-ups: @nora_sec @josh_infra @ellie_support @mariner_ops

-- thread end --
